test_title: PYST 18: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - GA (Held On: 14 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which water bodies flank the Peninsular Plateau on the east and west?

options.text: Bay of Bengal and Arabian Sea
Bay of Bengal and Indian Ocean

solution:
The Correct answer is __**Bay of Bengal and Arabian Sea**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Peninsular Plateau** is flanked by two major water bodies - the **Bay of Bengal** on the east and the **Arabian Sea** on the west.
 
• The **Bay of Bengal** is situated towards the eastern side of India and is the largest bay in the world. It receives water from major rivers like the **Ganges, Brahmaputra, Mahanadi, Godavari, Krishna, and Kaveri.**
 
• The **Arabian Sea** lies on the western side of India. It is part of the Indian Ocean and serves as a major route for trade and commerce.
 
• The Peninsular Plateau is bounded by these two seas, which contribute to its unique geographical location and climate.
 
• This plateau is triangular in shape and is surrounded by the **Eastern Ghats** and **Western Ghats.**
 
• The water bodies play a significant role in influencing the **climate, vegetation, and cultural practices** of the region.
 
• The presence of these seas makes the Peninsular Plateau a key geographical region for **trade, biodiversity, and natural resources.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Bay of Bengal and Indian Ocean**__

 __
 
• The **Indian Ocean** is the third-largest ocean in the world and lies to the south of India.
 
• While the Indian Ocean is significant for its role in global climate and trade, it does not flank the Peninsular Plateau directly, as the plateau is bordered by the Bay of Bengal and Arabian Sea.
 
 
 
• **Indian Ocean and Arabian Sea**__
 __
 
• Although the **Arabian Sea** is on the western side of the Peninsular Plateau, the Indian Ocean lies to the south of India and does not directly flank the plateau.
 
• It is important to note that the Indian Ocean influences the region's climate but is not the correct answer in this context.
 
 
 
• **Arabian Sea and Andaman Sea**__
 
 
• The **Andaman Sea** is located to the southeast of the Bay of Bengal and primarily borders the Andaman and Nicobar Islands.
 
• It does not flank the Peninsular Plateau, making this option incorrect.
